item.title: Furniture Clipart with Transparent Background – Isometric PNGs, No White Box
item.description: Every piece in this furniture clipart set is cut out on a transparent background, so it sits on any colour, photo or pattern without a white box. Shown on a checkerboard: egg chair, retro fridge, piano and cat tree. 28 cozy isometric home PNGs for design apps, crafts and mockups. AI-generated clipart.

item.title: Landlord Spreadsheet: Stop Chasing Rent Across Bank Apps, Emails and Notes
item.description: If your rental records live in bank apps, emails and sticky notes, this landlord spreadsheet puts them in one file: units, tenants, rent ledger, deposits, expenses, repairs and an annual summary of income and costs you can share with your accountant. Built for 1–10 long-term units. Your data stays in your own file. Not legal, tax or accounting advice.

item.title: 2027 Goal Setting Planner Printable: Turn Yearly Goals Into a Monthly Top 3
item.description: Write down up to six goals for 2027, each with why it matters, your first steps and notes. Then pick a top 3 for each month next to a mini calendar, and look back in a short monthly review. Part of the 2027 Goals & Habits Planner, in A4, A5 and US Letter, Monday or Sunday start.

item.title: Kitchen Counter Clipart – Isometric Sink & Sage Cabinet PNG
item.description: Kitchen clipart with a wooden worktop, sink and sage cabinets, drawn in cozy isometric 3D. Use it for recipe planners, meal-prep printables, cooking class slides or home renovation graphics. Transparent PNG, matched with a retro fridge, stove and dining set in the same 28-piece set. AI-generated clipart.

item.title: Cozy Kitchen Isometric Room – Kitchen Clipart Set with Fridge & Stove
item.description: A cozy kitchen put together from separate clipart pieces: counter with sink, retro sage fridge, cream stove and a round dining set. Use the transparent PNGs to design kitchen layouts, recipe book covers or food app onboarding. AI-generated clipart, one soft isometric style across all 28 pieces.

item.title: 2027 Weekly Planner Printable: 53 Weekly Pages With Top 3, Seven Days and Notes
item.description: One page per week, every week of 2027, including the week that starts in late December 2026. Each weekly page has the dates, a top 3 for the week, space for all seven days and notes. Part of the 2027 Minimal Planner with year overview and monthly spreads. A4, A5 and US Letter, Monday or Sunday start. Print a week at a time or bind the year.

item.title: Customer Service Email Templates for Selling Digital Downloads
item.description: The first buyer email arrives and the page stays blank. Copy-Paste Buyer Support Emails has eight complete replies to fill and send the same day: missing download, file won't open, shorter than expected, customize it, can I share this, refund request, will this make me money, and a broken link. Brackets mark the only blanks. PDF, 11 pages.

item.title: Landscape 2027 Digital Planner: Linked Year, Month, Weekly and Habit Tracker Pages
item.description: The 2027 Digital Planner is one linked PDF: a year page that opens each month, monthly pages that link to their weeks and habit tracker, 53 weekly pages that link back, a weeks index and notes. Landscape layout on a soft cream page, in Monday or Sunday start.

item.title: Tripod Floor Lamp Clipart – Minimal Isometric Home Decor PNG
item.description: Minimal home decor clipart: a wooden tripod floor lamp with a cream shade and terracotta details. Small items like this make a room scene feel lived-in, whether in a mood board, interior slide or isometric game mockup. Transparent PNG, part of a cozy 28-piece furniture clipart set. AI-generated clipart.

item.title: 2027 Planner Bundle: Printable and Digital Planners for Paper and Tablet
item.description: Three 2027 planners in one set: the Minimal Planner (year, monthly and 53 weekly pages), the Goals & Habits Planner (yearly goals, habit trackers and reviews) and the hyperlinked Digital Planner for tablets. 14 PDFs in A4, A5, US Letter and tablet landscape, Monday or Sunday start.

item.title: Editable House Rules Template for Rental Hosts: 8 Friendly Rules You Can Rewrite
item.description: A house rules printable that sounds friendly, not strict. It comes with 8 editable rules with sensible defaults, like quiet hours, no smoking, shoes off and locking up, and you can rewrite or clear any line. Fillable PDF for any free PDF reader plus an editable DOCX, in A4 and US Letter. Part of a 7-piece guest printable set for short-term rental hosts.

item.title: Cozy Clipart Bundle – Warm Isometric Home Pieces, Transparent PNG
item.description: Cozy clipart with a warm, lived-in feel: fireplace, rocking chair, coffee table with books, floor lamp, armchair and nightstand. Mix them for cozy aesthetic posts, hygge planners or slow-living blog graphics. Transparent background PNGs from a 28-piece isometric home set. AI-generated clipart.

item.title: Monstera Plant Clipart PNG – Isometric Houseplant in a Terracotta Pot
item.description: Houseplant clipart for plant lovers: a leafy monstera in a terracotta pot on a little wooden stand, in isometric style. Add greenery to room mockups, plant-care planners or cozy social graphics. Transparent background PNG from a 28-piece cozy home clipart set. AI-generated clipart, edited and cut out by hand.

item.title: Monday or Sunday Start 2027 Planner Printable: Pick the Week Layout You Already Use
item.description: Some people read the week from Monday, others from Sunday. The 2027 Minimal Planner includes both versions of every page, so the month grids and 53 weekly pages line up with the way you already plan. Six PDFs: A4, A5 and US Letter, each in Monday start and Sunday start.

item.title: Free Checklist: Know Before You Post in Online Groups (Green / Yellow / Red)
item.description: Most group removals aren't bad products — wrong place, wrong thread, or an account the filter doesn't trust yet. This free one-page printable walks you through a 10-minute rules check per group: where the rules live, ten fill-in questions, and a Green / Yellow / Red verdict before you hit Post. Print it. Fill one sheet per group. Reuse it.

item.title: Turn Something You Already Built Into Your First Paid Digital Product
item.description: Your first product doesn't need a new idea. List the tools, scripts, templates and notes you already use, the problems you've solved twice, and the questions people keep asking you. Circle one. This 9-step weekend playbook takes it from there: one buyer sentence, one offer, a kill list, one price and a listing draft, each with a fictional worked example. PDF and EPUB.

item.title: Interior Mockup Clipart – Isometric Furniture for Real Estate Graphics
item.description: Furnish empty-room graphics, listing flyers and open-house posts with cozy isometric furniture clipart. The sofa, coffee table, plant and front door shown here are transparent PNGs, so they sit cleanly on any background. A 28-piece set for agents, stagers and interior students. AI-generated clipart.

item.title: 2027 Monthly Planner Printable in A4, A5 and US Letter: Print Only the Months You Need
item.description: Print the whole year or just next month. The 2027 Minimal Planner has monthly two-page spreads: the month calendar, then blank holidays and birthdays fields, priorities and notes, so it works in any country. Six files are included: A4, A5 and US Letter, each in Monday or Sunday start. Print at 100% and double-sided to keep spreads together.

item.title: Isometric Bookshelf Clipart – Cozy Reading Corner PNG, Transparent Background
item.description: A tall wooden bookshelf filled with books and little plants, drawn as isometric clipart. It suits reading trackers, library-themed planner pages, book club invites and cozy study scenes. Transparent PNG with 27 matching home and furniture pieces in sage, cream and terracotta. AI-generated clipart.

item.title: 2027 Year at a Glance Printable: Every Day of 2027 on One Page for Trips and Deadlines
item.description: See all 365 days of 2027 on one page, with a column for each month, so trips, deadlines, birthdays and school breaks are easy to mark and spot. It's the year-at-a-glance page of the 2027 Minimal Planner, which also has a year overview, monthly spreads and 53 weekly pages. A4, A5 and US Letter, Monday or Sunday start.

item.title: 2027 Habit Tracker Printable: Monthly Grids for Up to 10 Habits, One Box per Day
item.description: A printable habit tracker for every month of 2027. Write up to 10 habits down the side and tick one box per day. Heavier lines mark each new week, so streaks are easy to see. The 12 trackers sit in the 2027 Goals & Habits Planner next to monthly goals and reviews. A4, A5 and US Letter, Monday or Sunday start.

item.title: Autumn Home Clipart – Cozy Isometric Fireplace & Armchair Scene
item.description: An autumn living room scene in warm terracotta: fireplace, armchair, coffee table, floor lamp and plant, framed with falling leaves. Use the transparent PNG pieces for fall planners, cozy-season social posts or seasonal shop banners. AI-generated clipart from a 28-piece home set.

item.title: 2027 Digital Planner for Tablet: Hyperlinked PDF With Month Tabs on Every Page
item.description: A landscape 2027 planner for tablet note-taking apps that open PDFs. Month tabs run down the side of every page and a top menu links to the year, months, weeks, habits and notes, so you tap to the page you need instead of scrolling. Write right on the page. Monday or Sunday start.

item.title: Hyperlinked Planner PDF: Month Tabs on Every Page and 9,492 Links, Everything One Tap Away
item.description: A hyperlinked planner you navigate instead of scroll. Month tabs sit on every page, a top menu jumps to Months, Weeks, Habits and Notes, and previous/next buttons link everything: 9,492 internal links in one undated tablet PDF. Tap links in your app's read or view mode, write in pen mode. 12 monthly, 52 weekly and 364 daily pages, Monday or Sunday start.

item.title: Terracotta Armchair Clipart PNG – Cozy Isometric 3D Furniture Illustration
item.description: Terracotta armchair clipart with plump cream and sage pillows, shown in isometric 3D. Use it for reading-nook graphics, cozy planner spreads or interior presentations. The PNG has a transparent background and belongs to a 28-piece cozy home clipart set in sage, cream and warm wood. AI-generated clipart.

item.title: Kill the Idea Before It Costs Your Weekend: 7 Questions Before Your First Digital Product
item.description: Before you spend a weekend building a digital product, answer 7 yes/no questions: Is it already free in the same form? Would you need credentials? Will it go stale in 3 months? Can you name where your buyer hangs out? Two or more yes answers and you drop it. From Ship Your First Paid Offer This Weekend, a playbook that takes you from idea to one paste-ready listing by Sunday night.

item.title: Cozy Planner Sticker Clipart – Isometric Home Icons for Digital Planners
item.description: Turn the furniture clipart into planner stickers: fridge for meal plans, desk for study blocks, washer for chores, nightstand for sleep. The transparent PNGs drop straight into digital planners or print as sticker sheets. AI-generated clipart, 28 cozy isometric pieces.

item.title: Cozy Double Bed Clipart – Isometric Bedroom Furniture PNG, Transparent
item.description: A made-up double bed with a terracotta throw and sage pillows, ready for bedroom clipart layouts. Pair it with the nightstand, dresser and rocking chair from the same cozy isometric set to sketch a calm bedroom. Transparent PNG, 28 matching home illustrations in total. AI-generated clipart for planners, slides and mockups.

item.title: Rent Tracker Template: See Who Owes Rent, Partial Payments and Late Rent at a Glance
item.description: This rent tracker template matches each payment to what was due. Partial and late payments are flagged green, amber or red, with days late and a running balance per tenant. Part of a landlord spreadsheet that also covers deposits, lease ends, repairs and expenses for 1–10 units. Standard .xlsx, any currency. Record-keeping tool only, not legal or tax advice.

item.title: Self-Promotion Rules: Post, Ask a Mod, or Stay Quiet?
item.description: Before you post your link in a community, answer ten questions: Is self-promotion allowed? Is there a promo thread? Are links allowed? Is there a minimum account age? Do you have to say you made it? The answers give one verdict per group. The groups kit turns that into a printable card plus post and reply scripts. For people who sell one PDF or template with no audience yet.

item.title: Sage & Terracotta Clipart – Earthy Isometric Home Illustrations PNG
item.description: Sage green and terracotta clipart in a soft, earthy palette: a sofa, armchair, fridge, vanity, door, egg chair, dining set, cat tree and crib, all in matching tones. Ideal for neutral brand boards, boho planners and calm social templates. Transparent PNGs, 28 pieces in all. AI-generated clipart.

item.description: Home office clipart in a cozy isometric style: a light wood desk with laptop and plant, plus a sage desk chair. Handy for study planners, work-from-home slides, productivity blog graphics and app empty states. Transparent background PNG from a 28-piece home clipart set. AI-generated clipart, commercial use under the included licence.

item.title: Sage Green Sofa Clipart – Isometric Furniture PNG with Transparent Background
item.description: A soft sage sofa with cream and terracotta cushions, drawn in a cozy isometric style. Drop it into living room mockups, moving-day cards or digital planners. It comes with 27 matching pieces, from a coffee table to a monstera, all as transparent background PNGs. AI-generated clipart, cut out and edited by the seller.

item.title: Vacation Rental Welcome Printables: Welcome Sign, House Rules, Wi-Fi and Check-Out in 10 Minutes
item.description: Give guests a polished, consistent welcome without designing anything. Seven editable printables in one calm style: welcome sign, house rules, Wi-Fi card, check-out sign, local tips, a good-to-know info sheet and a review-request card. Type straight into the fillable PDF in any free PDF reader, or edit the DOCX. A4 and US Letter included. For short-term rental and holiday home hosts.

item.title: Isometric Living Room Clipart Scene – Sofa, Armchair & TV Console PNGs
item.description: See how the pieces build a living room: sage sofa, terracotta armchair, coffee table, TV console, monstera and floor lamp on an isometric floor. item.title: Rental Property Spreadsheet for 1–10 Units: Rent, Deposits, Leases and Repairs in One File
item.description: A simple rental property spreadsheet for small landlords with 1–10 long-term units. Log rent as it arrives and the dashboard shows collected vs expected, who owes what, net income per unit, leases ending soon and open repairs. Any currency, no subscription, no bank connection. Standard .xlsx with a sample file. Record-keeping only, not legal or tax advice.

item.title: 2027 Minimal Planner Printable: Calm Year, Month and Week Pages With Nothing Extra
item.description: A calm, uncluttered 2027 planner for seeing your year, month and week at a glance. Clean lines, plenty of writing space and a small soft illustration each month. Includes a year overview, year at a glance, monthly two-page spreads, 53 weekly pages and key dates. Monday or Sunday start, in A4, A5 and US Letter. Prints well at home in colour or black and white.

item.title: Undated Digital Planner: Start Any Day, Any Year, and Never Waste a Page
item.description: Dated planners go blank by February. This undated digital planner has write-in month, week and day fields, so you start whenever you want and skip a week without losing pages. 452-page hyperlinked tablet PDF with 12 monthly, 52 weekly and 364 daily pages, plus habit trackers and notes. Monday-start and Sunday-start versions included. Instant download for PDF annotation apps.
